Blocks.Text: The DMA Feed Content API supports finders needed for feed DMA compliance. Standardized such that it only returns a collection of DMAFeedContent which can contain any ugcUrn, instantRepostUrn, commentUrn and reactionUrn. All finder results are sorted by creation time in descending order and disregard pagingContext field.
The service currently provides the following finder methods:

postsByAuthor - A collection of post urns (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost) authored by an organizational entity (urn:li:organization, urn:li:organizationalPage). Please use DMA Post BATCH_GET API to resolve the actual post object using the post urns.
commentsOnEntity - A collection of comment urns (urn:li:comment) on a provided entity (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost, urn:li:activity, urn:li:comment). Please use DMA comment BATCH_GET API to resolve the actual comment object using the comment urns.
reactionsOnEntity - A collection of reaction urns (urn:li:reaction) on a provided entity (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost, urn:li:activity, urn:li:comment). Please use DMA reaction BATCH_GET API to resolve the actual reaction object using the reaction urns.
repostsByReposter - A collection of instantRepost urns (urn:li:instantRepost) reposted by an organizational entity (urn:li:organization, urn:li:organizationalPage). Please use DMA InstantRepost BATCH_GET APIs to resolve the actual instantRepost object using the instantRepost urns. Instant repost is resharing a post without commentary.
repostsFromEntity - A collection of instantRepost urns (urn:li:instantRepost) on a provided post entity (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost). Please use DMA InstantRepost BATCH_GET APIs to resolve the actual instantRepost object using the instantRepost urns. Instant repost is resharing a post without commentary.
resharesFromEntity - A collection of reshare post urns (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost) on a provided entity (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost, urn:li:activity, urn:li:comment). Please use DMA Post BATCH_GET API to resolve the actual post object using the post urns. Reshare is resharing a post with commentary.
The finders for this API utilize the Pagination Cursor and Max Pagination Count pattern for pagination.
Please note the following restrictions of the API:

The value of the maxPaginationCount parameter cannot exceed 1000 for any single request.
Data returned by this API can be up to 48 hours delayed.
This API has a rate limit of 1 request per 60 seconds. An error will be returned if this rate limit is exceeded.
The latency for certain requests might at times exceed 10 seconds. If a timeout is experienced, wait 60 seconds then retry calling the API. Most requests should however have a significantly lower latency.

Rows.Text: Retrieve your organization’s posts, comments, reactions, and other engagement data. Retrieve your organization’s pages and their reporting data (including follower, visitor and content analytics). Restricted to organizations in which the authenticated member has one of the following company page roles. ADMINISTRATORCONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR

Blocks.Text: See Organization Access Control for more information on organization page roles.

Rows.Text: Unique URN representing DMA feed content.

Blocks.Text: The DMA Feed Content API requires specific URNs to identify entities such as posts, organizations, and other content. This section provides guidance on how to obtain the necessary URNs for making API calls.

A Share URN represents a post or content shared on LinkedIn. You can obtain Share URNs by calling the postsByAuthor finder method, which returns a collection of post URNs (including urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, and urn:li:groupPost) for a specified organization.
Description: Retrieves a list of post URNs (urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost) authored by the specified organization.
An Organization URN can be obtained directly from the LinkedIn UI. When viewing a company page or its admin dashboard, the page URL includes the organization identifier. For example:

SectionPath: 1. Retrieve a collection of post urns by author
Blocks.Text: To fetch scheduled posts, call postsByAuthor API to retrieve the posts by an organizational entity and then use DMA Post BATCH_GET API with viewContext=AUTHOR to retrieve the posts in AUTHOR viewContext. Among those posts, scheduled post payloads have scheduledAt fields. So API partners can filter the posts by checking whether post has scheduledAt or not to identify scheduled posts by an organizational entity.

Blocks.Section: How to fetch all the reshares of a post
SectionPath: 6. Retrieve a collection of reshare post urns reposted from the given content entity
How to fetch all the reshares of a post
Blocks.Text: InstantRepost (represented by urn:li:instantRepost) is a repost without commentary. Reshare (represented by urn:li:share, urn:li:ugcPost, urn:li:groupPost) is a repost with commentary. To fetch all the reposts of a post, please call both repostsFromEntity and resharesFromEntity and then merge results from these calls.
